name: Hillcreek Gardens Tagaytay
short_description: A 3.2-hectare former coffee farm and family estate near Tagaytay, now a one-stop garden wedding venue with an on-site hotel and chapel.
full_description: Hillcreek Gardens Tagaytay is a one-stop wedding destination set on a 3.2-hectare working coffee farm and private family estate in Alfonso, Cavite, just minutes from Tagaytay City. Established in 2008, the property has grown to include the Grand Ballroom, The Pavilion, a garden ceremony area, an on-site hotel, and its own restaurant, making it popular for weddings, corporate events, and staycations alike.
